Futbol24 is back — rebuilt from the ground up with a cleaner design, faster navigation and tools that go well beyond the scoreline.

Follow live scores across 2,000+ leagues and competitions worldwide, from the Champions League to your local division. Whether you're tracking one match or keeping an eye on a full matchday, Futbol24 gives you everything in one place.

WHAT YOU GET

Live Scores & Events
Real-time scores with goals, cards and status updates as they happen. The Live Events Box lets you filter by event type, pin it to the top, enable sound alerts, or show only your favourite matches.

Team Compare
Pick any two teams and compare them side by side — recent form, head-to-head record, latest results, Under/Over stats and a full stat-by-stat breakdown.

Lineups & Match Stats
Full formations, player positions and substitutions for every match. Plus live match statistics, a momentum chart and play-by-play commentary to follow the game even when you can't watch it.

Leagues & Teams
Dedicated pages for teams and competitions — with form tables, recent results and standings all in one view.

Organised Your Way
Sort matches by kick-off time, competition or country. Choose from different match display layouts. Find teams and competitions faster with improved search.

Light, Dark or Auto
The app follows your phone's system theme, or you can set it manually. Looks good either way.

COVERAGE
Over 2,000 leagues and competitions across Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia and Oceania — including the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, UEFA competitions and much more.

Futbol24 is free to download and use.
